structured_output.what_is_happening: "Super Intelligence" (SI) is a 36-minute-old PumpSwap pair. The token does not use a pump.fun mint suffix and its deploy platform is unknown, so the pool was probably created directly rather than through a curve migration. It shows about $6.6M of volume on a $104k market cap (37x turnover in an hour) and +60% in the hour. Liquidity ($179k) is larger than the market cap, 0% of the LP is locked, and there are few LP providers. GeckoTerminal counts about 922 unique buyers but only 40 unique sellers across roughly 3,400 sells. GMGN tags 144 bundler wallets, and the creator has closed out. This looks like manufactured bot or wash volume on a pool whose liquidity the creator controls. It is one of at least 10 SI / Super Intelligence tokens, and a pump.fun version already trades at about $711k.

narrative.description: Generic AI 'Super Intelligence' name. Several copies launched within the same few hours, which suggests some external trigger (possibly an AI headline or a tweet) that the packet does not show. There is no website, no DexScreener profile and no description. The only link is an X community whose ID looks like it was created around late 2024, so it may be reused.
narrative.why_spreading: Many copycat launches point to a short-lived theme wave. But this particular pair's activity looks driven by bots and volume farming, not by organic attention.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only thing tying the theme to this token is the name. It is not a pump.fun launch, it has no socials of its own, and it is not the largest version.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 82ez...pump SI ($711k mcap, created about 4.7h earlier, the likely leader), 9LUf...pump SI ($577k), Super Inu SI ($6.2M), and 6+ more copies.

authenticity.evidence: Only 40 unique sellers against 3,361 sells, about 84 sells per seller, which is the signature of a volume bot. Turnover is 37x in one hour on a $104k cap. GMGN tags 144 bundler wallets. Liquidity is larger than the market cap on a directly created, unlocked pool. The creator has closed out (creator_close). GMGN shows only 2 page visits despite millions in volume.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the 922 buyers may be real retail drawn in by the volume and price chart. Without X data, organic interest cannot be ruled out.

structural_risks: 0% LP locked/burned; 'Large amount of LP unlocked' danger flag; few LP providers, so whoever supplied the liquidity can pull it
Liquidity larger than market cap on a custom pool: a typical setup for draining the pool
Wash volume from about 40 selling wallets
Several larger same-name competitors split any attention

structured_output.counterargument: Unique buyers keep arriving (148 in the last 5 minutes), price is at its all-time high with steady +10% per 15 minutes, holders are widely spread (top 10 only about 9.7% outside the pool), and mint and freeze authority are renounced. The deep $179k liquidity also makes the price hard to push around. If the AI theme is getting real attention, a volume-farmed pool can still pull in enough retail to reach about $200k market cap before any liquidity pull, and only a 2x from about $104k is needed.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat SI token on a directly created PumpSwap pool with unlocked liquidity that the creator controls. Its volume is heavily bot-driven: about 40 sellers produce thousands of sells. Most likely it gets drained or bleeds out within hours. A 2x before -50% is possible but unlikely.
